text:
1218 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 11-23 to end of year:  
Nov: 30 - 23 = 7 days left in Nov.  
Dec: 31 days.  
Total remaining in 1218 = 7 + 31 = 38 days.  

283 days total, so after 38 days we reach 1219-01-01, leaving 283 - 38 = 245 days into 1219.  

1219 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = sum to 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
245 - 243 = 2 days into September.  

So date is 1219-09-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1219-09-02
